title: 食べ物のドット絵
lead: おにぎり・ラーメン・寿司・パンなど、食べ物をドット絵で描いた素材12点です。ゲームのアイテムやSNSのアイコンに使えます。
subject_en: Retro pixel art food items, each ONE dish or food centred, crisp pixels and a 1-pixel dark outline around the whole shape, limited bright palette. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a rice ball with a nori strip
a bowl of ramen with an egg and naruto
a slice of toasted bread with butter
a plate of curry and rice
a slice of pizza with melted cheese
a tall parfait glass with cream and a cherry
a cup of green tea beside a wagashi sweet
